subject: RFI: Control mapping & evidence intake for Polaris Financial
messages:
From: Tom Eaton <teaton@polaris.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Bright <sara.bright@polaris.com>, procurement@polaris.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFI kickoff: control mapping and evidence intake

Vanessa —

Thanks for taking this on. Polaris is running an accelerated RFP for our vendor assurance program and we need a clear control crosswalk (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG) and an evidence intake plan we can present to procurement and our security review board. Initial asks:

- High-level control mapping (which audits/controls map to SIG sections)
- Sample evidence artifacts for key buckets (access control, change mgmt, encryption, logging)
- Timeline for delivery and logistics for secure artifact transfer

Can you confirm what you can deliver by next Friday (12 Jan)? We'll need materials to prep our internal risk committee.

Tom Eaton
Director of Compliance
Polaris Financial
--
(attachment: polaris_rfi_template.xlsx - spreadsheet)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Tom Eaton <teaton@polaris.com>, Sara Bright <sara.bright@polaris.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jan 2028 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI kickoff: control mapping and evidence intake

Tom —

Appreciate the quick context. We're happy to support the accelerated timeline. Quick response on deliverables:

1) Control crosswalk deliverable (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 -> SIG) — draft by 2028-01-11, final by 2028-01-13 after your review.
2) Sample evidence bundle for top 12 SIG questions — initial packet by 2028-01-09.
3) Secure artifact transfer options: secured SFTP, customer-specific shared Drive with limited access, or RedWoods secure intake portal (we'll share an invite).

Looping in Karthik (security solutions) and Marissa (assurance lead) to coordinate evidence extraction and who will be the point for artifact packaging.

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment call tomorrow to confirm scope and any constraint (data residency, redlines, escalation contacts). When today/tomorrow works for you?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Eaton <teaton@polaris.com>, Sara Bright <sara.bright@polaris.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jan 2028 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI kickoff: control mapping and evidence intake

All —

Thanks for the context. I pulled together a preliminary scope of evidence we typically provide for SIG-heavy reviews and flagged three potential gating items for Polaris (data residency for logs, KMS/HSM key proofs, and 3rd-party subcontractor attestations).

I'm attaching: 1) redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (high-level SOC 2 scope and control owner list), 2) redwood_network_diagram.png (sanitized infra diagram), and 3) a suggested column layout for the control map (will populate Polaris RFI spreadsheet once we confirm the authoritative SIG questions).

Notes:
- We can provide Hash/manifested archives for logs, but confirm whether you require raw logs or summarized evidence.
- For KMS key provenance, we can provide HSM certs and KMS rotation policies; full private key material is never shared.

Marissa — can you own the sample evidence packet and a short write-up for the risk committee that explains what each artifact demonstrates?

Karthik Iyer
Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf - pdf)
(attachment: redwood_network_diagram.png - image)
From: Sara Bright <sara.bright@polaris.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Eaton <teaton@polaris.com>, procurement@polaris.com
Date: Thu, 5 Jan 2028 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI kickoff: control mapping and evidence intake

Vanessa / Karthik —

This is great, thanks. A couple of clarifications from legal/risk:

- Can you confirm redwood_network_diagram.png is SANITIZED (no IP ranges, no internal service names)? We'll need that to circulate to our board.
- For the sample evidence packet, will you include timestamps and a short verification checklist (what to look for) so our reviewers can validate without needing a technical deep-dive?
- For artifact transfer, our procurement team prefers signed DocuSign intake and SFTP with IP whitelisting. Do you support both?

Also, would you be open to a short recorded walkthrough of the evidence packet so internal reviewers can watch instead of scheduling multiple calls?

Sara Bright
Security Program Manager | Polaris Financial
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Bright <sara.bright@polaris.com>, Tom Eaton <teaton@polaris.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Jan 2028 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI kickoff: control mapping and evidence intake

Sara —

Confirming details and next steps from our side:

- Network diagram: confirmed sanitized; all hostnames/IPs removed and services generalized. You may circulate to internal stakeholders.
- Sample evidence packet: attached will be a 12-item bundle with a one-paragraph verification note for each artifact (what it demonstrates, typical validation steps, and red flags).
- Transfer options: we support DocuSign for intake forms and SFTP with IP whitelisting. We can also provision a temporary access token for your secure Drive. Procurement, if you'd like the SFTP details we can share an access SOP after PO/DSA stage.

I've attached the initial sample control map (polaris_rfi_control_map.xlsx) with our suggested mapping populated for a subset; we'll expand once we get the final SIG questionnaire.

Proposed schedule:
- 2028-01-06: 20-minute recorded walkthrough shared (link) + short Q&A notes
- 2028-01-09: Sample evidence packet delivered (zipped manifests + verification notes)
- 2028-01-11: Draft control crosswalk delivered to Polaris for review

If that works, Vanessa — please lock the recorded walkthrough time. Tom/Sara — does Thursday 2028-01-06 at 10:00 PT work for a brief live walkthrough (will record)?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Assurance Lead | Redwood Inference
(attachment: polaris_rfi_control_map.xlsx - spreadsheet)
From: Tom Eaton <teaton@polaris.com>

Date: Sat, 7 Jan 2028 08:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI kickoff: control mapping & evidence intake for Polaris Financial

Team —

Thursday 10:00 PT works for a live walkthrough; recording would be helpful for our review board. Procurement will share the DocuSign template and SFTP whitelist details by end of day Monday.

One ask from our legal: please include a short statement in the evidence packet describing any retained data (logs, traces) retention policy and where deletion/archival occurs. That will make it much easier for the privacy team.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Tom
Director of Compliance | Polaris Financial
